AD.measuredFor: Andorra, all parishes, flats for rent on Pisos.ad, EUR per m2 x 75 m2
AD.note: Pisos.ad Q2 2026 quarterly report: 117 flats for rent, average area 105.15 m2, average rent EUR 26.94 per m2 (Andorra la Vella 24.45, Escaldes-Engordany 30.73); times 75 m2. Asking rents on one portal; the Govern d'Andorra's contract-based rent study (Nov 2025) reports far lower contract rents (about EUR 9.9 per m2) because it covers old leases, so a new let is nearer the portal figure. Very thin.

AE.measuredFor: Dubai emirate, all areas (used for the UAE; Abu Dhabi is dearer, the northern emirates cheaper)
AE.note: Published as AED 77,000 a year; divided by 12. Median of registered new Ejari tenancy contracts for flats of 70 to 110 m2 (DLD does not publish bedroom counts for flats, so floor area stands in for a two-bed), 12 months to 16 Nov 2026, 84,161 contracts, all areas of the emirate. Processed by dubairealestatedata.com (CC BY 4.0) from the DLD open data on Dubai Pulse, which we could not reach directly from here.

AR.measuredFor: Buenos Aires city (CABA) only, written under the country code because no free rent series exists for other Argentine cities
AR.note: Proxy: CABA stands for the country. Rents in Cordoba, Rosario and the provinces are lower. IDECBA, the city's statistics office, on Argenprop ads published in pesos for used flats; provisional data; asking prices, not signed leases; excludes building fees. Local room convention: 'ambientes' counts the living room, so a 3-ambientes flat is a living room plus two bedrooms, the match for a two-bed. The unit price is the average price per m2 times a fixed 70 m2; actual 3-ambientes flats average 63 m2.

AU-VIC.measuredFor: Melbourne (used for the state): Melbourne metropolitan region (31 municipalities), two-bedroom units, median weekly rent of the current quarter
AU-VIC.note: Median weekly rent AUD 610 x 52 / 12. REIV (Real Estate Institute of Victoria, an industry body, not a regulator) Victorian Insights page, Units tab, Metro, 2 bedrooms. REIV says its data come from real estate professionals; sample size and quarter not stated. Stand-in only: the official Victorian Rental Report (new bonds, 2-bed flats by LGA) is hosted on dffh.vic.gov.au, which refuses connections from this network. Regional Victoria 2-bed units: AUD 410 a week. Two-bedroom houses in metro Melbourne: AUD 615. Low confidence.. Written for AU-VIC from Melbourne's row: no state-wide figure

AU-WA.measuredFor: Perth (used for the state): Perth, Perth Metro region (Greater Perth, not the city centre), two-bedroom units, median weekly rent of the latest rolling three months
AU-WA.note: Median weekly rent $720 x 52 / 12. REIWA (Real Estate Institute of Western Australia, an industry body, not a regulator) Perth Metro page, Unit panel, 2BR rent, three months to October 2026, page data updated 8 Nov 2026. Rent method and sample size not stated by REIWA; its FAQ counts leasing days from advertising on reiwa.com to the lease contract date, so the rent is probably of new leases. Not bond data: the WA Bond Administrator publishes none. Unit overall $700, 1BR $600, 3BR $790; two-bedroom houses $650. Cross-check: SQM Research asking rent, 2-bed units, Perth capital city, $697.75 a week, week ending 12 Nov 2026.. Written for AU-WA from Perth's row: no state-wide figure

Kept in US dollars as published. US$153 a year per m2 = US$12.75 a month per m2, x 75 m2 = US$956. San Isidro: US$161 a year = US$1,006 at 75 m2. Cross-checks: Ubicasa (13 Nov 2026) Miraflores median S/41 per m2 on 619 listings = S/3,075 at 75 m2, about US$902 at S/3.41 per dollar; Urbania Lima-wide 2-bed median S/2,281 (July 2026).

MN.note: Fallback only. NSO experimental estimate for August 2026, as reported by iKon.mn; NSO's own release was not found online (its PxWeb API carries sale prices but no rent table). Asking rents from unegui.mn listings, six central districts only. Mongolians count the living room, so a 3-room (3 өрөө) flat is two bedrooms plus living room, the nearest match to a 70-85 m2 two-bedroom; this room-count reading and the typical size (one listing found was 66 m2) are not stated by NSO. 2-room (1 bedroom) average is 1,930,000 MNT, 1-room 1,400,000. Series for a 3-room flat: Dec 2025 3.06m, Feb 2026 3.01m, Jul 2026 2.95m, Aug 2026 3.03m. The iKon.mn headline says 2-room 1.85m, but its text says 1.93m (1.85m is February's figure), so the text is used. Sep 2026 and later not found. Highest: Sukhbaatar district (Sukhbaatar Square, 220 mingat) 3-room 4.9m; Bayangol 3-room 2.2m; Khan-Uul Zaisan/River Garden 3-room 4.06m.

MO.measuredFor: Macao SAR, all residential units with a lease in force (not only new lets), per m2 of usable area; all size bands
MO.note: DSEC Rental Statistics Q3 2026: average rent MOP140 per m2 of usable area x 75 m2 = MOP10,500. Rents come from lease declarations for property tax filed with the Financial Services Bureau; the average covers every unit with an unexpired lease, so it lags the going rate for a new let. DSEC rents are per usable area, which is smaller than gross area, so 75 m2 usable is a large flat. Size bands in Q3: under 50 m2 MOP168, 100-149.9 m2 MOP129, 150+ m2 MOP124; the 50-99.9 m2 band was not in the release text (Q1 2026: MOP139, so about the same as the all-flat average). Districts: Doca do Lamau MOP154, Baixa de Macau 119, Barca 117, ZAPE 122, Areia Preta and Iao Hon 121. Q2 2026 was MOP140, Q1 2026 MOP140, year on year -0.1%.

NUTS-PL213.note: National figure for two 45-year-olds who have just moved there. Statutory 844.77 PLN (voluntary statutory base the supplementary plan relies on: NFZ voluntary health insurance (dobrowolne ubezpieczenie zdrowotne). Open to foreigners who hold a temporary residence permit, permanent residence permit or EU long-term resident permit, who have no insurance title elsewhere in the EU and are not insured as a family member (NFZ guide, 14 Sept 2023). 844.77 PLN for two) + private plan LUX MED (Medicover and Enel-Med are close), LUX MED mid-tier subscription 'Komfort' (supplementary): 520.00 PLN for two. Freenance table, 'approximate as of Q1 2026 for individual plans', adult age 25-45: LUX MED mid tier about PLN 260 a month; PLN 260 x 2 = PLN 520. Medicover Standard about PLN 310, Enel-Med Rozszerzony about PLN 220. Rankomat (May 2023) gives LUX MED Rozszerzony PLN 275 and Kompleksowy PLN 370 for ages 0-70.

Rule: health contribution = 12.5% x IBC; IBC for independent workers and rentistas de capital = 40% of monthly income received (net of real or presumed costs), never below 1 SMMLV (COP 1,750,905 in 2026) nor above 25 SMMLV. Floor: 12.5% x 1,750,905 = COP 218,863 a month. Worked example, income COP 20,000,000 a month with 27.5% presumed costs: IBC = 20,000,000 x (1 - 0.275) x 0.40 = 5,800,000; health = 12.5% x 5,800,000 = COP 725,000. Cap: 12.5% x 25 x 1,750,905 = COP 5,471,578. The income-dependent part is the whole amount above the floor. Pension contributions (16%) are separate and not counted. The spouse is added as a beneficiary at no extra premium (standard rule, not checked in a saved source). Whether foreign-source capital income counts, and the presumed-cost percentage in force (27.5% or 28.08%), were not confirmed. Private prepaid plans (Colsanitas, Sura) are the usual choice for the wealthy; no published table found. Source: co-salud-independientes-2026)

ZA.note: local private plan 16496 ZAR (South Africa, national: couple on an open medical scheme (community rated, so the same at any age), main member plus one adult dependant, total contribution including the medical savings account; Discovery Classic Smart Comprehensive; recommended row. Discovery Classic Smart Comprehensive, 1 Apr to 31 Dec 2026: main member R8,576 + adult R7,920 = R16,496 a month (of which R1,286 + R1,188 goes to the medical savings account). AL.note: National figure for two 45-year-olds who have just moved there. Statutory 6,800.00 ALL (voluntary statutory base the supplementary plan relies on: FSDKSH voluntary membership of the compulsory scheme (Law 10383/2011). FSDKSH page: 'Per sigurimet shendetesore vullnetare, baza e llogaritjes se kontributit eshte dyfishi i pages minimale', contribution rate 3.4 per cent. The Fund page says that for foreigners the residence-permit number serves as  6,800.00 ALL for two) + private plan Albsig and others (Sigal quotes only on request), local private plans, basic to comprehensive (supplementary): 88.33 EUR for two. Guide listing Albsig plans from EUR 450 a year (basic) to EUR 610 a year (top tier), and local plans generally EUR 450-760 a year; midpoint of the Albsig range EUR 530 a person a year x 2 / 12 = EUR 88.33 a month. Secondary source, not a tariff; priced in euro as quoted.

AT.note: National figure for two 45-year-olds who have just moved there. Statutory 819.80 EUR (compulsory: One full ÖGK contribution of €565.25 plus a spouse supplement of 3.4% × €7,486.80 = €254.55. Assumes no child-rearing or care exemption.) + private plan Austrian private insurers (comparison-site table, no insurer named), Sonderklasse Komfort plus Privatarzt/Wahlarzt (ambulant) tariff (supplementary): 450.00 EUR for two. Source gives monthly ranges by age: age 40 Komfort 110-150, Privatarzt 35-85; age 50 Komfort 150-200, Privatarzt 50-120. Age 45 is the interpolated midpoint: Komfort 152.50 + Privatarzt 72.50 = 225 EUR each, x2 = 450. Interpolation is the agent's, not the source's. Source says the figures are indicative guides from public insurer information (20 April 2026).

BE.note: National figure for two 45-year-olds who have just moved there. Statutory 620.75 EUR (compulsory: INAMI/RIZIV personal contribution, 2 x 931.12 EUR a quarter, as in the first round (2 x 310.375 a month).) + private plan Mutualite Chretienne (MC), Hospi +200 (hospitalisation insurance, single room) (supplementary): 63.94 EUR for two. Brochure 2026 gives 31.97 EUR a month per adult aged 25-49, for people who subscribe before age 45; a surcharge applies for subscribing after 45 and the brochure does not give its size, so 2 x 31.97 = 63.94 is a lower bound for a 45-year-old couple. Market guides quote 60-90 EUR a month per person for single-room cover (secondary, comparator site).

BG.note: National figure for two 45-year-olds who have just moved there. Statutory 49.62 EUR (compulsory: NHIF contribution for two people with no other insurance basis (8% x EUR 310.10 each, from 1 Aug 2026); compulsory for long-term or permanent residents. Same figure as the file's `amount`.) + private plan DZI, Bulstrad, Euroins (named by the source; no insurer tariff reached), local voluntary top-up plan (supplementary): 130.00 EUR for two. Source's profile row 'Age 45, single or couple: EUR 50-80 individual' per month; midpoint EUR 65 x 2 people = EUR 130 a month. A broker's indicative range, not an insurer tariff. A second guide (Innovires) lists Bulstrad EUR 300-850 and Allianz Bulgaria EUR 400-1,200 with no column headers (probably annual); not used.

CY.note: National figure for two 45-year-olds who have just moved there. Zeno Legal indicative market range for ages 35-50: 700-1,200 EUR a year per person; midpoint 950 / 12 = 79.17 a month each, x2 = 158.33. Not a tariff: a law-firm guide says there is no regulated tariff.

CZ.note: National figure for two 45-year-olds who have just moved there. Product tier and date are not stated by the broker. A search excerpt of Charles University's Slavia price list (2025) shows about CZK 1,200 a month for a basic foreigners' policy, so this is mid-range rather than basic.

(Agent's first choice, CHF 4,000 franchise at CHF 252 each = CHF 504, is kept in the notes; changed by the component owner to match Switzerland's standard-franchise definition.) 2026 monthly premium, adult 21+, with accident, franchise CHF 4,000: CHF 252.00 each; x2 = CHF 504.00 a month. Ordinary franchise (CHF 500): CHF 392.00 x2 = CHF 784.00. Franchise 1,500: 352x2=704. Franchise 2,500: 312x2=624. Check that the figures are monthly: the cost-sharing table says the CHF 1,500 franchise gives a discount of CHF 480 a year; 392-352 = 40 a month = 480 a year. 2027 tariff (published): CHF 268 (franchise 4,000) and CHF 412 (ordinary) each, so CHF 536 and CHF 824 for two.) + private plan FKB (Liechtenstein), Kombinierte Spitalversicherung semi-private, age 41-50, no franchise (supplementary): 488.00 CHF for two. Statutory 7,927.20 TRY (compulsory: SGK general health insurance (GSS) from the second year of residence: 12% of twice the daily minimum wage x 30 (the file's computation; one premium for the couple if the spouse counts as dependant). Feather (Q1 2026 indicative): age 45, single, TRY 10,000-22,000 a year; midpoint TRY 16,000 / 12 = TRY 1,333.33 x 2 = TRY 2,666.67 a month. The source says Turkish premiums rise 50-80% a year, so a November 2026 quote is probably higher. Year one only; from year two GSS applies and private cover is optional, so the table should not add both without a decision.

XK.note: National figure for two 45-year-olds who have just moved there. Statutory 140.00 EUR (compulsory: Compulsory insurance under Law 10/L-028: 7% x 2 x minimum wage a person; minimum wage EUR 500 from 1 July 2026; 0.14 x 500 = EUR 70 x 2 = EUR 140. Whether the Fund yet collects it from permit holders is unconfirmed.) + private plan Not named (guides mention Illyria and Sigal; no tariff), local private health insurance (supplementary): 100.00 EUR for two. One guide gives 'Health insurance EUR 50/mo' for a single person in Pristina; x 2 = EUR 100. Another gives USD 20-50 basic and USD 100-300 comprehensive. Weak.
